description: How many times a digit occurs in the nth look-and-say term. Term 5 is 111221, so it has four 1s and two 2s. A digit from 4 through 9 occurs zero times in the classic sequence. n runs from 1 to 25, and the digit runs from 0 to 9. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/look-say-count
